name: Not My Circus
summary: Jasper Geartoggle asks you to help keep abandoned animals fed in Powderfuse Port. He needs Briny Seafood Stew before the hungry beasts cause trouble.

sections.title: Hungry Beasts
sections.body: In Powderfuse Port, Jasper Geartoggle asks you for help with the animals left in his care. Their owners blame him when a horse, wolf, or other beast dies or runs away. He needs Briny Seafood Stew to keep them in check, before hunger drives them into a stampede.

faq.answer: Jasper Geartoggle asks you to help feed the animals left in his care.
Jasper needs Briny Seafood Stew for the animals in his care.
Jasper says the animals are hungry and he needs food to keep them in check.

faq.q: Where should I bring the stew?
faq.answer: Bring the Briny Seafood Stew to Jasper Geartoggle in Powderfuse Port.

faq.q: Why are animals being left with Jasper?
faq.answer: People keep leaving their horses, wolves, and other animals with Jasper.
